results.answer: On the Pro plan, the Orders API limit is 1,200 requests per minute for each API key. For comparison, the Catalog API allows 3,000 per minute on the same plan. This comes from the Usage limits page of the developer docs.
The highest-rated tent is the Ridgeline 2P Tent. It's rated ★ 4.8 from 412 reviews and costs $349.00. Of the five tents in the catalog, the next best is the Trailhead 1P Tent at 4.6.
The Cedar Camp Stool costs $42.00. I searched the store, and it came up as the only result. Its product page lists it as a folding three-leg stool rated 4.5 stars from 133 reviews.
Order #10427 was placed on March 23, 2026. It was for a Basecamp 4P Tent and shows as Delivered. I found it on page 3 of your order history.

I sent the support message as Dana Reyes (dana.reyes@example.com) about order 10427. It says: "The tent zipper broke on the first trip." The confirmation page said "Thanks, we got your message" and that support replies within one business day.

I saved your settings. Your newsletter is now monthly and SMS order alerts are off. Email order alerts are still on, as you had them. The page showed "Settings saved," and the new values were still there after the page reloaded.

I added the Ridgeline 2P Tent to your cart and went to the checkout page. The order total is $349.00. It will ship to Alex Rivera, 12 Fern Street, Portland, OR 97201, and payment is from your store credit, which has a balance of $800.00. I didn't place the order.

You have 14 days from delivery to return a sale item. Items marked "final sale" can't be returned at all. For comparison, full-price items can be returned within 60 days. This is from Pinecrest Outfitters' "Returns and exchanges" help page.
Rinse the rain fly with cold water and a mild soap, then let it air dry completely before packing it. Don't machine wash or tumble dry it, because heat damages the waterproof coating.

I couldn't find a warranty period because Pinecrest Outfitters doesn't seem to sell a "Summit 4P" tent. It isn't in the catalog, and going straight to its product page (id=summit-4p) gives "Page not found." The closest names are the Summit Dome 3P Tent ($389) and the Basecamp 4P Tent ($429). The Summit Dome 3P page doesn't list a warranty either.
